title: Research AMD Core + Tactical Ladder over 2021–2026
body:
Implements an isolated quantity-based Core + Tactical Ladder research state machine, not a change to Alpha OS recommendations. Base is feature/risk-backtest-v1; existing PRs are not merged.

The fixed control sells/buys 5% of original executed AMD shares after 2% moves from the last actual fill, retaining a 50% original-share core. References freeze at quantity boundaries. One pending order, one fill per session, later-open execution, actual gap prices, 5 bps commission/slippage each side, $100,000 initial capital, zero cash yield, no leverage/shorting/top-ups. Buy quantities are cash- and previously-sold-unit constrained. Fractional/whole lots and one-shot partial cancellation policies are explicit. PR #2 target-weight/HOLD restoration execution is unsuitable for this fixed-quantity policy; its Bar/time schema and assumptions are reused while its executor remains unchanged.

Actual data: 1,458 AMD OHLCV sessions, 2021-01-04 through 2026-10-22. Raw Yahoo chart response, normalized data, reported corporate actions, retrieval time, dataset version and SHA-256 hashes are committed. No in-window splits/dividends are reported and adjusted closes equal OHLC closes throughout. No adjusted/unadjusted series mixing; 2026-10-23 is excluded. Generic known nominal-price splits are handled prospectively; action-bearing provider packs require a conversion/payment-date ledger and are refused by this adapter rather than silently approximated.

Full-history comparison after modeled costs:
| Metric | Buy & Hold | Fixed Ladder |
|---|---|---|
| Final capital | $550,887.46 | $494,460.40 |
| Total return | 450.89% | 394.46% |
| CAGR | 34.23% | 31.75% |
| Maximum drawdown | -65.45% | -63.00% |
| Sharpe, RF=0 | 0.806 | 0.783 |

The control gives up 56.43 percentage points of total return for a 2.45 pp shallower worst drawdown. All 144 neighboring full-history configurations underperform Buy & Hold by return while reducing maximum drawdown to different extents; no winning parameters are selected. The 2024–2025 deep cycle shows an 18.08 pp local drawdown reduction with an independent restart versus approximately zero under inherited state, demonstrating why reset experiments cannot be attributed to the continuous policy.

Seven completed >=10% peak-to-recovery cycles, the open cycle, all 24 calendar quarters and the September–October 2026 diagnostic are included. Each has independent and inherited-state comparisons (132 rows). The grid includes 144 parameter combinations across full/development/validation-independent/validation-inherited windows (576 rows), 48 commission/slippage/delay cases and five rounding/partial cases: 629 sensitivity rows total. Development is 2021–2023; subsequent chronological validation is 2024–2026, explicitly not claimed as an unseen prospective holdout.

Outputs: reports/core-tactical-ladder/report.md, summary.csv, trades.csv (38,305 tagged fills), daily-equity.csv, position-history.csv, episodes.csv, sensitivity.csv, events.csv, cash-impact.csv, regime-summary.csv, validation.md and standalone PNG/SVG capital/drawdown/allocation charts. FIFO recovery diagnostics retain prior lots across continuous reporting boundaries; cash/share decomposition reconciles relative NAV exactly.

Validation: 97 tests passed, 25 subtests passed; no failures/skips. Includes declines, bounces, oscillations, quantity boundaries, gaps, affordability, future-information exclusion, publication constraints, fees/slippage, chunk/episode state inheritance, duplicate executions, splits, partial fills, grid/control preservation and all printed-account conservation. Compilation, source/output hashes, SVG parsing and staged whitespace checks passed. Original Decision Engine, Tactical Risk Overlay and executor hashes are unchanged.

Limitations: retrospective provider vintages and inferred publication times are not independently verified PIT inputs. The daily adapter rejects publication after the following session open; asynchronous feeds need a separate event-clock adapter. No broker-level settlement, tax, liquidity reconstruction, independent action completeness or dividend ledger is claimed. Episode boundaries/regime labels are retrospective diagnostics, never trading signals. The control does not demonstrate a more favorable overall risk/return profile on this sample; no effectiveness or production-readiness claim follows. No main, Railway, PostgreSQL, Redis, live service, live trading or merge changes.
